newsitem.title: INDIA: Two former ITC chairmen put in custody.
newsitem.headline: Two former ITC chairmen put in custody.

text.p: Two former chairmen of cigarette company ITC Ltd, who were arrested early on Friday for alleged foreign exchange violations, were remanded in judicial custody until November 13 by a local court, officials said.
Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Parthasarathi Das ordered K.L. Chugh and J.N. Sapru into judicial custody until November 13.
Earlier, K.K. Kabirpanthi, deputy director of the eastern regional office of the Enforcement Directorate, said Chugh and Sapru were charged with violating the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act (FERA).
"We have arrested them and handed them over to police," Kabirpanthi told reporters outside the Enforcement Directorate's offices.
The direcorate on Friday also summoned ITC chairman Y.C. Deveshwar for further questioning in connection with the foreign exchange violation case.
"We have summoned Deveshwar to appear before us for interrogation on November 4," said K.K. Kabirpanthi, deputy director enforcement (eastern region).
